candidate_import_validation_steps_define: 1. JSON syntax validation (json.load, fail closed on parse error)
3. Artifact-ID consistency validation (declared artifact_id matches the FW-CAP-DISPATCH-004 mission ID)
4. Source-hash format validation (64-char lowercase hex sha256, same HEX64 pattern as perception.src.common)
6. Duplicate-name detection (case-insensitive observed_name collision check within one packet)
7. Category normalization review (observed_category preserved verbatim + a separately recorded normalized_category, never overwritten in place)
8. Canonical-hint format review (canonical_hint, when present, must be a well-formed URL or explicitly null -- never guessed)

9. Epistemic-state review (every candidate must start IDENTITY=UNVERIFIED, SAFETY=NOT_ASSESSED, LICENSE=NOT_ASSESSED, MAINTAINABILITY=NOT_ASSESSED, INSTALLATION=NOT_INSTALLED, AUTHORITY=NOT_GRANTED, PROMOTION=NOT_ELIGIBLE -- ingest.py raises if any candidate arrives pre-set to a stronger state)
10. Claims-integrity review (no free-text claim in the source packet is copied into a structured field without an explicit uncertainty/provenance marker)
